description: This file defines the TransactionDeletionRecord class for handling transaction deletion processes in an ERP system, including validation, data cleanup, and related operations.

classes.name: TransactionDeletionRecord
classes.description: A Document subclass managing the deletion of transactions, including validation, cleanup, and related data operations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates user permissions and doctypes to be ignored.

methods.name: validate_doctypes_to_be_ignored
methods.description: Ensures only allowed doctypes are in the ignored list.

methods.name: before_submit
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations before submitting the document.

methods.name: delete_bins
methods.description: Deletes stock bins related to the company.

methods.name: delete_lead_addresses
methods.description: Deletes addresses linked to leads of the company.

methods.name: reset_company_values
methods.description: Resets financial values of the company.

methods.name: delete_company_transactions
methods.description: Deletes transactions and related data linked to the company.

methods.name: get_doctypes_to_be_ignored_list
methods.description: Returns a list of doctypes to be ignored during deletion.

methods.name: get_doctypes_with_company_field
methods.description: Retrieves doctypes that have a link to the Company doctype.

methods.name: get_number_of_docs_linked_with_specified_company
methods.description: Counts documents linked to the company.

methods.name: populate_doctypes_table
methods.description: Adds doctype info to the internal table if not present.

methods.name: delete_child_tables
methods.description: Deletes child table records linked to the company.

methods.name: delete_docs_linked_with_specified_company
methods.description: Deletes documents linked to the company.

methods.name: update_naming_series
methods.description: Updates the naming series for a doctype.

methods.name: delete_version_log
methods.description: Deletes version logs related to the doctype and company.

methods.name: delete_communications
methods.description: Deletes communication records linked to the doctype and company.
